name: smwsprites-big-timed-lift
title: Big Timed Lift
description:
This is a big 64x32 version of the Timed Lift (sprite BA), with some extra features. You can customize the timer between 1 and 255 seconds (or make it go on forever), set different movement types for each lift with different speeds, and more.

See the .asm file for customization options and details on using the extra bytes.

Replaces the Rex in GFX20 (SP4). No more sprite tile limits patch is strongly recommended (included in SA-1).

Requires the included CircleX and CircleY routines for the circle movement to work properly on LoROM when using large radii.
